description: This file defines an interface 'AppRepository' that serves as a repository boundary for app data within a Kotlin-based Android project. The interface includes methods to retrieve UI titles and initial counter values based on screen keys, functioning as a simple in-memory data source.

classes.name: AppRepository
classes.description: Interface defining data retrieval methods for application screens, including fetching titles and initial counters.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns a user-visible title for a given screen key.

methods.name: getInitialCounter
methods.description: Returns the initial counter value for a given screen key.
